parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of steel, forming the main structural body that supports all other components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, houses insulation, and supports the doors and internal compartments.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door (Left Door)
parts.Basic_description: The left door of the refrigerator, made of steel with insulation inside, provides access to the freezer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the freezer section to maintain low temperature and prevent air leakage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Door (Right Door)
parts.Basic_description: The right door of the refrigerator, made of steel with insulation, provides access to the main cooling compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the refrigerator section to maintain internal temperature and prevent condensation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Other (Dispenser Unit)
parts.Basic_description: A plastic dispenser unit integrated into the refrigerator door, typically used for dispensing water or ice.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to access chilled water or ice without opening the door, improving energy efficiency.
parts.Movement_description: It contains small moving parts like levers or buttons for dispensing but is mostly fixed in place.
